data_source: Synthea synthetic FHIR R4 fixtures included with MEVA (data/synthetic/synthea/patient-01.json, patient-02.json, patient-03.json). See docs/synthetic-data.md for provenance. No real patient data is used anywhere in this dataset.
description: Expanded, structured benchmark suite for MEVA's local agent + verifier pipeline. Every expected_evidence_facts entry was generated directly from the real Synthea bundles (see examples/inspect_benchmark_data.py) and checked by src/meva/benchmark/validator.py before being committed. 37 cases exercise the live local model (AGENT); 3 cases test MEVA's deterministic verifier directly with a hand-written wrong claim (VERIFIER_CHALLENGE) and must never be reported as model performance.
limitations: This is an engineering/research benchmark sample, not a clinical validation study. 40 cases are not sufficient for statistical claims about model reliability.
Evidence Grounding Score and tool-selection metrics measure whether an AI's claims match retrieved FHIR records, not diagnostic or clinical correctness.

Only 3 synthetic patients exist in the fixture data, so allergy/medication/condition cases necessarily reuse the same underlying resources from multiple question angles rather than drawing from many different patients.
Observation cases involving repeated measurement types (e.g. multiple blood pressure readings per patient) are scoped to the first recorded instance to keep expected values unambiguous.
Tool over-calling is measured but not penalized in scoring; only required-tool coverage affects pass/fail.
